scenarios.name: Visitors & New Users
scenarios.note: Tested guest browsing, validation, duplicate registration guard, and guest-to-member transition across 5,000 personas.

scenarios.name: Registration, Auth & Session
scenarios.note: Simulated local email verification, session expiry/refresh, and local biometric stub (distinct from real hardware biometric).

scenarios.name: Profiles & Member Graph
scenarios.note: Tested profile completion, search, follow/block state, and privacy checks in isolated simulation state.

scenarios.name: Chats, Ordering & Dedup
scenarios.note: Tested private and room messaging, concurrency ordering, read/delivery states, and duplicate message prevention.

scenarios.name: Media, 60s Live Audio & Call Limits
scenarios.note: Enforced 60s max live audio cap, separated live vs uploaded audio, rejected oversized/corrupt files; live WebRTC/hardware audio-video calls not claimed as real device tested.

scenarios.name: Rooms, Bookings & Rentals
scenarios.note: Tested public/private/rental rooms, booking conflict rejection, cancellation/refund/expiry, and state integrity.

scenarios.name: Wallet, Coins & 24h/7d/30d Plans
scenarios.note: Tested isolated virtual wallet balances, atomic concurrent transactions, and 24h/7d/30d entitlement durations using synthetic test values only.

scenarios.name: Ads & Reward Idempotency
scenarios.note: Tested simulated ad slots, reward calculation, duplicate reward prevention, and ad load failure/expiry handling with zero real ad network calls.

scenarios.name: Super Owner & RBAC
scenarios.note: Tested server-side role/permission checks, audit logs, and isolated test admin actions; no production accounts used.

scenarios.name: Screens, States & Navigation
scenarios.note: Inventoried 61 screen/page/view files and 11 test files in platform codebase; verified empty/loading/error handling patterns.

errors_and_limitations.root_cause: Termux CLI simulation environment does not execute real hardware biometric sensors or live peer-to-peer WebRTC media transport.
errors_and_limitations.remediation: Keep simulated stub results explicitly labeled in reports; run real-device integration tests separately on physical iOS/Android devices against isolated emulators.
